jude-letter.name: Jude
jude-letter.role: Writer who calls himself a servant of Jesus Christ
jude-letter.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
jude-letter.importance: He plans to write about a shared salvation. He writes instead to urge his readers to defend the faith. He warns of men who crept in and denies their teaching. He ends with orders. Build yourselves up and pray. Show mercy to some, and snatch others from the fire.
jude-letter.connections: He identifies himself as a servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James.

jesus.name: Jesus Christ
jesus.role: Master and Lord, source of mercy
jesus.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
jesus.importance: Jude says certain men deny him as the only Master and Lord. Readers are told to keep in God’s love and look for his mercy. That mercy leads to eternal life.
jesus.connections: Jude identifies himself as his servant and warns against denying him.

word.languageNote: This is the dictionary form of the name “Jesus.”

moses.name: Moses
moses.role: Man whose body Michael and the devil argued over
moses.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
moses.importance: Jude says Michael argued with the devil about the body of Moses. Michael did not dare to curse the devil. He said, “May the Lord rebuke you!” Jude says the men he warns about speak evil of what they do not know.
moses.connections: Michael, the archangel, argued with the devil about his body.

cain.name: Cain
cain.role: Man whose way Jude warns against
cain.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
cain.importance: Jude says the men he warns about went in the way of Cain. Jude does not say here what Cain did. The warning ends in woe.
cain.connections: Jude places his way beside Balaam's error and Korah's rebellion.

balaam.name: Balaam
balaam.role: Man whose error was done for hire
balaam.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
balaam.importance: Jude says the men he warns about ran in the error of Balaam for hire. The phrase “for hire” ties his error to payment. Jude gives no story of Balaam here.
balaam.connections: Jude names him with Cain and Korah.

korah.name: Korah
korah.role: Man whose rebellion ended in destruction
korah.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
korah.importance: Jude says the men he warns about perished in Korah’s rebellion. Jude gives no story of Korah here. The name shows that rebellion ends in ruin.
korah.connections: Jude names him with Cain and Balaam.

enoch.name: Enoch
enoch.role: Seventh from Adam, who prophesied judgment
enoch.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
enoch.importance: Jude says Enoch prophesied about the men he warns about. Enoch said the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones. The Lord comes to judge all the ungodly for their works and words.
enoch.connections: Jude calls him the seventh from Adam.

adam.name: Adam
adam.role: First man, named to place Enoch
adam.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
adam.importance: Jude names Adam only once. He uses the name to say Enoch was the seventh from Adam. Jude tells no story about Adam.
adam.connections: Jude calls Enoch the seventh from Adam.
